Here are eight of the new films and series arriving on India's streaming platforms from Friday, 13 November to Sunday, 15 November.

Netflix adds three on Friday: the Telugu period drama Ranabaali, streaming in Telugu, Hindi, Tamil, Kannada and Malayalam; Daayra, a crime thriller directed by Meghna Gulzar; and the English mystery thriller Heartland.

Also on Friday: the Hindi thriller series Student of the Year: After Dark on JioHotstar, the Hindi family comedy Parivarik ManuRanjan on Sony LIV and the Malayalam gangster drama Bandra on ZEE5.

On Sunday, Netflix adds the English comedy series Cunk on Cinema, and Prime Video adds The Chosen Season 6.
